name: flightqueue
description: Flight Queue plugin for Codex and ChatGPT. Airport security wait times and forecasts, FAA delays, EES border queues, lounges, terminals and airline baggage performance for 8,000+ airports.

interface.longDescription: Answer real travel questions with live airport data. Get the security wait at any airport right now, a forecast for a future departure, the best time to arrive for a given flight, current FAA ground stops and delay programs, EU Entry/Exit System border queues, lounge access, terminal layouts, aviation weather and airline baggage performance. Covers 8,000+ airports.
defaultPrompt: What is the security wait at JFK right now, and when should I arrive for an 8am departure?
